marker.description: Blue-headed pin inserted into the anterior cranial fossa, pointing towards the crista galli.

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the pin.
main_explanation: The pin is inserted into the crista galli, a midline bony ridge on the ethmoid bone that projects superiorly into the anterior cranial fossa. It serves as an attachment point for the falx cerebri.

supporting_question.question: Which dural fold attaches to the structure indicated by the pin?
supporting_question.explanation: The crista galli is the attachment site for the falx cerebri, a sickle-shaped fold of dura mater that separates the two cerebral hemispheres.
